Themes & Desktop tutorial

aether on Omarchy

Turn any wallpaper into a matching color scheme for your whole Linux desktop.

Package data synced 2026-10-19 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install aether on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add aether. It is a 13.6 MB download (21.2 MB installed), version 4.32.0-2, licensed MIT. Desktop theming application - extract colors from wallpapers and apply cohesive themes. Free and open source (MIT licensed, open source).

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install aether on Omarchy

Aether analyzes a wallpaper's colors (using a median-cut palette algorithm with several extraction modes and fine-tuning sliders) and generates a cohesive 16-color theme from it, then applies that theme across 20+ apps like Hyprland, Kitty, Alacritty, VS Code, and Neovim. It also bundles a wallpaper browser/downloader for wallhaven.cc, an image editor with filters, and a library of built-in presets (Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, Catppuccin) plus 250+ importable Base16 community schemes.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add aether
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 4.32.0-2:
    pacman -Qi aether

Open and use aether

aether is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql aether | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install aether on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add aether. The download is 13.6 MB and it takes 21.2 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is aether free?

Free and open source (MIT licensed, open source). The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall aether?

Run omarchy pkg drop aether. It removes the package from your system.

What does aether depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: webkit2gtk-4.1, gtk3. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is aether a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for aether.

Is aether in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as aether (version 4.32.0-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom/aether. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
